output.reason: The release note alone [ev-02bb073cfa55] is vague, but the linked PR fills the gap. [ev-d0e4491132a9] says the change adds a referential-integrity check to user-defined RBAC roles, ensuring that at least one policy defines a permission for each role. The check runs through `argocd admin settings rbac validate` and also when policies load, where a warning is logged; [ev-f8b486d989d4] finishes that sentence with "that references it", so the result is a log warning, not a rejection. The motivating issue [ev-1db77c2b3143] shows the exposed case: a group bound to a role name that no policy defines (e.g. `role: admin` with a space). Together these give the subject (RBAC policy role references), the change (validation added) and the consequence (a warning is logged; existing behaviour is not blocked).
